definitions.pairing: Each regenerated stream, mapping, profile hash and original scenario seed is checked against the saved source cell before simulation.
definitions.reporting: Equal-weight means of condition-wise policy/agent ratios. Preserve every cell, including losses to any economical control.
definitions.retained_controls: Copy and report all specified retained economical controls and protected history/once alternatives alongside new controls. Their raw rows are unchanged.
definitions.safe_arrival10_allowance_025: Use the exact fixed10_cap proposal (ten cumulative family arrivals and the old forecast allowance), then the same .25 protection as PACE.
definitions.safe_count_025: Replace only H_hat=min(N*age/(age+5),1/h) by min(N,1/h) in the PACE economic proposal. Preserve expected failed-attempt pricing, m*min(T,age), all other proposal terms, and the same .25 protection.
definitions.safe_earliest_allowance_025: Use the exact earliest_cap proposal including F+C_fail <= max(0,S)+max(0,H_hat*s), then the same .25 global budget, reservations, and manifest control as PACE.
definitions.safe_projected_allowance_025: Use the exact projected_cap proposal (PACE projected economics and old forecast allowance), then the same .25 protection as PACE.
definitions.scope: Prespecified controls prompted by an independent review. No policy tuning or outcome-based exclusions. Local simulation only, with no model/device calls.
definitions.selection: All 600 existing main-grid conditions and all 12 existing recorded-arrival conditions. No outcome-based exclusion.
definitions.shared_environment: Same measured compiler, completed-trace eligibility, service-before-compilation, artifact reuse, detected-failure fallback, TTL, known costs and hazard, and family-arrival/attempt-indexed outcome channels as retained PACE records.
definitions.storage: Group+scenario key uniquely names each result. Freeze checks all 612 output paths before evaluation.
